notes: Series-parallel AC network: V-AC 1 -> R 0 (4k) -> node that splits into two series branches, R 3 (4k) + C 4 (0.2uF) and R 5 (2k) + L 6 (5mH), which rejoin at the bottom return node carrying GND 2. Net map: n1 = source lead, the wire leaving the top terminal of R 0 at (365,34) and running off the top edge of the crop to V-AC 1; n2 = upper node of the parallel box, the near-horizontal wire y~186-190 from (326,190) to (424,186), T-joined from above by the lower lead of R 0 at (380,188) and dropping at each end to the top of R 5 (left, x~327) and the top of R 3 (right, x~426); n3 = short vertical link x~435 from the bottom lead of R 3 (y~284) down to the top plate of C 4 (y~327); n4 = short vertical link x~346 from the bottom lead of R 5 (y~300) down to the top lead of L 6 (y~322); 0 = bottom return node = box bottom wire from the L 6 bottom lead (355,401) across to the C 4 bottom plate (440,362), plus the stub that T's off that wire at (407,439) and runs down to the bottom edge of the crop at (411,477), plus the long left-hand line that GND 2 T's into at (192,231) and the second V-AC terminal. Judgment calls: (a) V-AC 1 is NOT visible - its bbox is (201..256, -68..0), entirely above the top of this 512 crop, and the ink in the image starts abruptly at y=34 and stops abruptly at y=477 (four separate strokes end at y=34: x=6, x=163, x=365, x=449; three end at y=477), which is a crop boundary, not four coincidental line ends. So the source and its wiring were cut off and its two terminals had to be inferred from circuit sense. (b) The R 0 top lead is the only conductor leaving the top of the crop anywhere near the V-AC bbox on the right, so it is taken as one source terminal (n1). (c) The GND 2 symbol is wired to the right by a short horizontal run that dead-ends in a clean T on the long left-hand line at (192,231) - verified at 16x, the long line continues above and below the T, so this is a junction, not a crossing. That long line runs the whole height of the crop, (163,34) to (229,477). Since a ground net must return to the source and the box's bottom node also sends a stub off the bottom edge at (411,477), the two off-crop wires are read as meeting below the frame: GND, the box bottom node and the second V-AC terminal are all one net, named 0. (d) The other two full-height lines, x=6->(51,380) on the far left (which dead-ends in mid-air) and x=449->(505,477) on the far right, touch no component and no other wire (separate connected components even after a 3px close), so they are treated as ink from a neighbouring drawing on the same page and are not part of any net. If (c) is wrong the alternative is that the right-hand line carries the return instead of the left-hand one, but the net partition is identical either way. (e) 2-terminal parts are indexed top-then-bottom as drawn; order does not affect any metric.
